properties.digitized_from: DataSF Parcels -- Active and Retired (blklot 8705011, real cadastral land-parcel boundary)
properties.digitization_method: REPLACED 2026-09-18 (second correction, after the owner flagged the first fix was still tracing individual building rooftops rather than the site itself): the real Assessor land parcel 8705011 -- the same one this parcel's condo-style unit lots are all mapped against -- gives the full rectangular site boundary (grounds, courtyard and building together), matching the owner's own sketch of what the shape should look like, rather than a tight building-only outline. Still real, official DataSF cadastral data, not a hand trace.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- official DataSF Assessor parcel boundary (blklot 8705011), ~6093 sq m, not a hand trace or plan estimate. 301 King St, 313 units per secondary sources, opened 2006, architect Arquitectonica. This is the whole site/land parcel, not just the building's rooftop -- it includes any courtyard, landscaping or parking within the lot line. The parcel is condo-mapped for ownership purposes across many individually owned per-unit lots sharing this same footprint (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson), so no single blklot represents one owner and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can.
